name: Qwen3-4B to 1.7B Dual-H100 GKD Distillation Optimization v1

work.agent_query: Read AGENT_TASK.md and optimize the supplied full BF16 Qwen3-4B-to-1.7B GKD distillation training step on two CUDA GPUs (compute capability 8.0 or newer, at least 79 GiB each, NCCL). Preserve the initialized solution, implement build_objective and optionally build_model_patch/build_teacher_patch according to runtime.api, use the public tests for development, record retained experiments, and leave FINAL_VERSION on the strongest validated version.

dual-cuda-sm80-80g-nccl.interconnect: NCCL over any CUDA peer transport (NVLink used for qualification; a non-NVLink pair is admitted with scripts/preflight.py --allow-non-nvlink)
dual-cuda-sm80-80g-nccl.notes: Capability envelope enforced by the trusted runtime (gkd_lab/runtime/distributed_probe.py) and by the Judge controller (e2e_formal_controller.py); GPU model, UUID, clocks and the qualification peak-memory bytes are recorded as measurement provenance only. The 79 GiB floor covers the largest scored workload with headroom; it admits an H100 SXM 80 GB card (81,559 MiB), and the student plus a replicated frozen 4B teacher does not fit a 40, 48 or 64 GiB card.

primary.notes: The score is a ratio against the official TRL reference, which is re-measured live on whatever devices ran the candidate; it carries no frozen device constant. Absolute throughput (tokens/s) behind the ratio is comparable only within one measurement profile.
